title: Degree of a finite product
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $\iota$ be any type, let $s$ be a finite set of indices in $\iota$, and for each $i\in\iota$ let $g_i:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{F}_2$. The algebraic degree of the pointwise product of the functions indexed by $s$ is at most the sum of their algebraic degrees.
hypotheses_covered: $s$ is a finite set of indices in $\iota$
$g$ assigns a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube to every index
